lists.name: RYM Top — Reggae / Ska / Dancehall — Roots Reggae

podcast.body: Recorded in Jamaica with the production crew Sly & Robbie, this double reggae album allowed Sinead to finally record "War" by Bob Marley, a song that previously got her into trouble on *Saturday Night Live*. "In 2005, she released Throw Down Your Arms, a double reggae album recorded in Jamaica with the production crew of Slian Robby."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
